aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The params_to_dependencies dependency is the primary async signal because stale Depends/Security/Param marker shapes directly affect downstream dependency graph construction and request execution.
The routing_to_openapi dependency captures route metadata and default propagation consumed by OpenAPI/schema logic.
The encoder_to_response dependency captures jsonable_encoder and Pydantic compatibility behavior consumed by response-model filtering.
Route/TestClient probe execution requires a pinned FastAPI dependency environment; selectors are public and observable but local execution remains a quality gate.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Path, Query, Depends, and Security helpers must return marker objects with stable dependency, use_cache, scopes, default, alias, and FieldInfo semantics for dependency solving.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when parameter marker probes and dependency cache/security probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The dependency agent may build Dependant graphs against stale marker object fields or cache-key semantics.

dependency_points.contract_summary: APIRoute and FastAPI route registration must expose stable names, operation IDs, response fields, default response classes, callbacks, and router include metadata to OpenAPI/schema consumers.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when route registration/default probes and OpenAPI operation/schema probes pass together.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The schema agent may generate OpenAPI against stale route metadata, operation ID, callback, or default response class assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: jsonable_encoder and Pydantic compatibility helpers must provide stable include/exclude, alias, default, custom encoder, and nested model serialization behavior consumed by response filtering.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when jsonable_encoder and response-model filtering probes pass together.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The routing agent may serialize or filter responses against stale Pydantic compatibility or encoder include/exclude semantics.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves FastAPI parameter marker, dependency solving, routing, response serialization, and OpenAPI contracts.
